title: Text overflow from expander container in sidebar
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary ### Reproducible Code Example ```Python with st.sidebar: with st.expander( "Demo data", icon=":material/dataset:", ): st.markdown( """ **Storage** - bucket1/awesome_zoom_background.jpg - bucket2/folder1/folder2/lenna.png **Database tables** cities, countries, messages, teams, users, users_teams """ ) ``` ### Steps To Reproduce _No response_ ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Current Behavior _No response_ ### Is this a regression? - [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.62.0 - Python version: 3.11.12 - Operating System: WSL - Browser: Chrome ### Additional Information _No response_

comments.body:
**If this issue affects you, please react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your feedback helps us prioritize which bugs to investigate and address first.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-16618)

Long unbreakable markdown (file paths in list items) overflows the bordered `st.expander` when it is placed in `st.sidebar`. This looks like a CSS min-content issue rather than an expander animation bug: markdown uses `overflow-wrap: break-word` (and `word-break: break-word` only on `p`, not `li`), which does not shrink a flex item’s min-content width, while the expander details panel is `overflow: visible` with no `min-width: 0`. Nested flex layout (sidebar → expander → block) then lets long tokens paint past the expander border. A likely fix is `overflow-wrap: anywhere` / `word-break` on list content plus containing overflow on the expander panel. `#12366` addressed the same wrapping class in bordered containers and shipped in 1.49, but this 1.52 sidebar+expander case still reproduces.

**Related issues:**
- https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/12366 — Same long-token markdown overflow in a bordered container; closed by adding `overflow-wrap: break-word`, which appears insufficient inside the sidebar expander flex layout.
- https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/6394 — Long markdown (inline code) overflowing nested alert containers; same wrapping failure mode in a constrained parent.
- https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9387 — Nested content overflowing the sidebar viewport (`st.popover`); related sidebar overflow, different mechanism (positioning vs. text wrapping).

**Note**: This is a markdown list sizing regression rather than an `st.expander` or sidebar bug. 
Top-level lists carry `width: fit-content`, which is floored at `min-content`, and the `overflow-wrap: break-word` above it does not reduce `min-content` width — so a list holding an item too long to fit is sized to that item and never wraps. Paragraphs have `width: auto` and are unaffected, which is why the prose wraps and only the bullets spill. Introduced by #13036 (`text_alignment`) and shipped in 1.52.0.
**Impacted**: any container narrower than the longest list item. The sidebar clips the overflow, so the text is lost rather than just misaligned. 
**Not impacted**: full-width lists, lists whose items fit, nested lists, and widget labels.
